description: Get a download URL for the deck as native PowerPoint or PDF. PowerPoint exports as real editable shapes, text and charts — not pictures of slides. The reply also names what the chosen format drops (the soundtrack, embedded fonts), the same sentences the web editor's export banner shows. Open the link in a browser signed in as this account: the export routes are owner-scoped, and on a free workspace they answer with the server's own unlock message.
name: export_deck
title: Export a deck
